snippet.title: Le capitaine de l'OM te demande si t'es « le petit qui a refusé le 10 »… (ÉP 22)
snippet.description:
Le jour du Classique, une banderole « Le 2 du district » t'attend devant le Parc. Dans le tunnel, le capitaine de Marseille te toise. Pendant 80 minutes, tu ne perds pas un duel. À la 85e, tu tacles leur ailier, l'arbitre siffle penalty… et la VAR montre que tu as touché le ballon en premier. Sur le contre, 70 mètres, une-deux avec le 9, pied gauche : 1-0. Au club-house du district, quarante gamins sautent sur les tables.
Le vrai fait : le 26 mai 1993, à Munich, l'OM bat le Milan AC 1-0 en finale de la Ligue des champions, but de la tête de Basile Boli. Pendant 32 ans, c'est le seul club français champion d'Europe, jusqu'au PSG en 2025, dans la même ville.
Le soir, la star de l'équipe t'invite à une grosse soirée. Problème : le huitième de finale de Ligue des champions est dans 48 heures. Écris ton choix en commentaire : le plus écrit décide de la suite.

snippet.title: Karma Just Hit HP Printers. Hard.
snippet.description:
HP built its printer business around cheap hardware and expensive ink. Then it went even further.

With Dynamic Security, some HP printers can reject third-party or refilled cartridges. Its Instant Ink subscription can also disable cartridges when a customer stops paying, even if ink is still inside. The strategy was designed to keep users locked into HP’s ecosystem. But the backlash is growing.
HP has faced lawsuits, regulatory action, and increasing frustration from customers who feel they no longer fully control the hardware they paid for. At the same time, competitors are pushing refillable ink-tank printers that can run for years without constant cartridge replacements. And now HP is selling ink-tank printers too.

The company that helped create the cartridge subscription problem may be getting forced to compete against it.

snippet.title: Upgrading your attic insulation is one of the best ways to cut energy bills! 🔥🏠
snippet.description:
Upgrading your attic insulation is one of the best ways to cut energy bills—but if installers blow loose insulation right up against a hot furnace, water heater, or fireplace flue pipe without a metal shield, they’ve just built a hidden attic fire hazard! 🔥🏠⚠️


Even cellulose or fiberglass treated with fire retardants cannot safely sit directly against a hot exhaust vent:

The Unshielded Insulation Trap (Left): When blown-in insulation buries the base of a metal flue pipe, heat can no longer dissipate into the attic air. Surface temperatures skyrocket, drying out adjacent roof rafters and igniting trapped dust, paper fibers, and wood framing right out of sight!

The Attic Insulation Shield Standard (Right): The International Residential Code (IRC Section M1801.12 & G2427.10.12) strictly requires a rigid sheet-metal attic insulation shield (minimum 26-gauge galvanized steel extending above the insulation depth) around every chimney and Type B gas vent passing through an insulated attic. That open-top metal collar holds insulation back at the manufacturer's required air clearance (typically 1 inch for B-vents and 2+ inches for single-wall/factory-built chimneys) so heat escapes safely upward!

Having new insulation blown into your attic—or inspecting an older home? Always verify that every metal flue pipe is protected by a galvanized attic insulation shield! 🛠✨

snippet.title: I Used Gouache Paint Cups as Stamps to Bring This Bare Tree to Life! 🌳🎨✨
snippet.description:
I pressed the cups onto the paper, leaving little blocks of yellow and green around the branches. Then I tapped the colors together with my brush until those blocks started to look like clusters of leaves. 🍃

The gouache is so creamy that you can see the texture of each dab! My favorite part was where the bright yellow met the lime green… it made the top of the tree look like it was catching the sunlight. ☀️💚

Should I try this with fall colors next? 🍂👀
